name: @heliuslabs/shared-key-storage-examples
description: Private Squads smart accounts and Swig wallets built on the Shared Key Storage SDK: helpers, scripts and tests

scripts.test: pnpm build:sdk && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts test/smart-account/*.test.ts test/swig/*.test.ts
scripts.test:devnet: pnpm build:sdk && SA_NETWORK=devnet node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/network/*.test.ts
scripts.test:mainnet: pnpm build:sdk && SA_NETWORK=mainnet node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/network/*.test.ts
